description: Source code implementing a mustache template rendering library with multiple internal versions and interfaces, including functions for processing templates from files, memory, and file descriptors.

classes.name: wrap
classes.description: Structure used internally for version 2 and mini mustach implementations to hold context for template processing.

classes.name: iwrap
classes.description: Structure used internally for legacy version 1 implementation to hold context for template processing.

classes.name: prefix
classes.description: Structure used internally for managing indentation prefixes during template processing.

methods.name: wrap_emit_esc
methods.description: Emits escaped buffer content through the interface.

methods.name: wrap_emit_raw
methods.description: Emits raw buffer content to the file.

methods.name: wrap_enter
methods.description: Handles entering a section in the template.

methods.name: wrap_next
methods.description: Handles moving to the next item in a section.

methods.name: wrap_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key.

methods.name: mustach_file
methods.description: Main function to process a template string with a given interface and output to a FILE pointer.

methods.name: wrap_emit
methods.description: Emits buffer content, escaping if necessary.

methods.name: wrap_put
methods.description: Retrieves a value and emits it.

methods.name: mustach_fd
methods.description: Processes a template from a file descriptor.

methods.name: mustach_mem
methods.description: Processes a template from memory and returns the result.

methods.name: fmustach
methods.description: Convenience function to process template from string and output to FILE.

methods.name: fdmustach
methods.description: Convenience function to process template from string and output to file descriptor.

methods.name: mustach
methods.description: Convenience function to process template from string and get result in memory.
